_meta.description: SMART-LM prototype rule set. These rules are based on commonly understood requirements under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 and subsequent amendments. ALL RULES MARKED prototype=true MUST be verified against current official Government of India Legal Metrology documents before any real enforcement use.
_meta.source_note: For official rules, refer to: Legal Metrology Act 2009, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, and all amendments issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India.

rules.requirement: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) must be declared on every package
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(d) — prototype reference
rules.description: Every package of a commodity shall bear a declaration of the Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes.

rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 — prototype reference
rules.description: MRP declaration must be in the format 'MRP Rs./₹ X.XX (inclusive of all taxes)' or equivalent.

rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(b) — prototype reference
rules.description: Every package shall bear a declaration of the net quantity in standard units (g, kg, ml, L, pieces).

rules.requirement: Name and address of manufacturer, packer or importer must be declared
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(c) — prototype reference
rules.description: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must appear on the package.

rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture or packing must be declared
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(e) — prototype reference
rules.description: Every package shall bear the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed.

rules.requirement: Consumer care details (address/phone/email) must be declared
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules 2017 — prototype reference
rules.description: Consumer care contact details (address, telephone number, or email) must be mentioned on the package.

rules.requirement: Country of origin must be declared for imported commodities
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(k) — prototype reference
rules.description: Country of origin is mandatory for imported goods. For Indian goods, it is good practice.

rules.requirement: Best before / expiry date must be declared for perishable commodities
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(f) — prototype reference
rules.description: Best before or expiry date in DD/MM/YYYY or Month-Year format is mandatory for perishables.

rules.requirement: Unit sale price must be declared where applicable
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 — prototype reference
rules.description: For commodities sold by weight or volume, the unit sale price per kg/litre may be required.

rules.requirement: Name or generic name of the commodity must be declared
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(a) — prototype reference
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name or generic name of the commodity contained therein.
